comment: ERROR BUDGET, broken half, measured on the PRODUCTION path. One genuine ERROR node produces TWO rows here — the analyzer's own walk and the engine's, which both fire on `rootNode.hasError` and are merged at `engine.ts`. That duplication is pre-existing and belongs to the engine, not to this lane; the pin states the real production number rather than the analyzer-only one, because a fixture that pins a number the product never publishes is a fixture that cannot fail on a real regression. What this file exists to hold is the CAP: the pre-fix analyzer's walk was UNBOUNDED while the engine's is capped at 50, so a file with N broken constructs published up to 2N rows for N lines, and the two walks used different child sets so the duplication was not even reliably 2x. `expectErrorCount` exists because `expectErrors` is a >=1 match and cannot see two copies of one error at all.

expectErrors.message: Syntax ERROR detected. The Brain Engine is bypassing this broken node.
